title: Stock Photos
description: Search Pixabay and your own galleries from the object editor. Photos you drop on a field are copied into it with their alt text and credit.

pixabayKey.label: Pixabay API Key
pixabayKey.help: Sign up at pixabay.com, then copy your key from pixabay.com/api/docs. The key stays on the server; the browser never sees it. Photos are used under the Pixabay Content License.

galleries.label: Library Galleries
galleries.help: Galleries editors can pick photos from, each shown as a tab in the panel in this order. A photo is copied into the field with its alt text, credit, tags, link and focal point; after that the copy is independent, and deleting it from the gallery changes nothing.

safeSearch.label: Safe Search
safeSearch.help: Only show Pixabay photos suitable for all ages.

defaultOrientation.label: Default Orientation
defaultOrientation.help: The orientation filter the search panel starts with, for every source.
